graph.name: socius
graph.note: Node-link format (networkx / graphify compatible). Edge "relation" = relationship type; see docs/map/README.md. Ids: a module is its path, a symbol is path#name, other ids have a type prefix. Module membership and area are node fields (source_file, area), not edges; calls/uses inside one file are omitted; a test importing a source module appears only as the tested-by edge of that module (symbol-level calls from tests are in the vault notes). Private helpers are folded into their module.
